factor_name: VIX stress and downside-breadth conditioned 3-day volatility-scaled reversal

calculation.expression: -(close/close.shift(3)-1)/(rolling_std(pct_change(close),20)*sqrt(3)) when VIX > rolling_median(VIX,60) and VIX > rolling_mean(VIX,20) and cross_sectional_mean(I[pct_change(close,5)<0]) > 0.55; otherwise NaN
calculation.description: Ranks assets for short-horizon mean reversion only when market volatility stress and broad five-day downside breadth jointly indicate a selloff regime. The reversal is normalized by each asset's 20-day volatility. Signal uses information through the completed date and is paired with next-day forward return for validation.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2020-2022 (IC 0.074405, ICIR 0.213619), 2023-2025 (0.031756, 0.093175), and 2026-2031 (0.039193, 0.102333). Conditional coverage is low and uncertainty is material in the 15-instrument universe.
